name: authors_variant
description: What the authors' StreamSpot code does, rebuilt by us (model/authors_variant.py). Values confirmed on 2026-11-16 against github.com/ubc-provenance/kairos commit 0e0b633, StreamSpot/src/train.py and test.py. Used as an ablation, never as the headline.
negative_sampling: one random destination per edge, drawn from 0..negative_range; draws that are not a node of the current graph go to one reserved empty row (D-22); the scoring pass reseeds with authors_seed at the start of every graph

_provenance.memory_dim, embedding_dim, time_dim, nei: authors' StreamSpot/src/train.py (memory_dim = time_dim = embedding_dim = 200; LastNeighborLoader size=5; max_node_num = 5045000; Adam lr 0.0001; BATCH=1024; 10 epochs)
_provenance.graph_score, threshold, authors_seed: authors' StreamSpot/src/test.py (graph loss = mean loss per edge; threshold = max validation loss; torch.manual_seed(12345) at the start of each graph)
_provenance.ours: one graph at a time with local ids and memory reset between training graphs (D-17); reserved empty row for the random node (D-22)
